Route guidance (PM-suggested route, dev may re-cut against measurement): shape **2** (mechanical sha stamp on the union run) is the only one that doesn't rely on anyone remembering, but shape **1**'s contract line ("run the union after the final commit; quote `git rev-parse --short HEAD` from that run") is the cheap immediate cover and **3** (ratchet-family-only re-run) is its targeted subset. A sensible single card: land 1+3 as contract text now, and 2 as the mechanical successor if the wrapper is cheap enough to include.

Guardrail note for dispatch/review: if the fix edits `.claude/skills/**`, the skills-update guardrail applies (human merge, terminal three-piece); `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` is agent-definition text — either way the PR must flag its path surface so review takes the maintainer-merge fork deliberately, not by noticing late.

Related: #8545 (wrong invocation) and #8553 (blind detector) are sibling failure modes in the same family — deliberately not packaged; no shared acceptance criterion.

Size/model suggestion: S if contract-text only, M with the wrapper; fable-mandatory only if `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` is touched.
